title: Prayer to St. Joseph II
text:
Oh, Saint Joseph, foster-father of Jesus, most pure spouse of the Virgin Mary, pray for us daily to the same Jesus, the Son of God, that we, being defended by the power of His grace and striving faithfully in life, may be crowned by Him at the hour of death.
Amen.
notes: Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).
